//: Isolated STANDALONE typecheck for the Fluido library. It compiles ONLY the pure core with no DOM lib and `types: []` (no repo tsconfig, no @types/node): the core is facts in, a decision out, and runs on the CLI, in the browser and in a worker alike. If it ever reaches for the DOM or Node, this fails. Run: `npm run check:fluido`. The import-boundary gate (tools/check-ownership.js checkFluidoBoundary) guards runtime imports; this guards the type surface.
